lines.en: label kirinspring2:
scene sky
Some people say that enduring stressful situations together is enough to make people closer. But I’m not sure who those people are because I don’t understand how or why.
lines.zh: 有人说，一起熬过高压的处境就足以让人变得亲近。可我不知道说这话的人是谁，因为我不明白怎么会、又为什么会。

lines.en: Because for me, the things that remind me of what I’d rather not be reminded of sit atop the list of what I must avoid for sake of my sanity.
lines.zh: 因为对我来说，那些让我想起不愿想起之事的东西，排在我为了保住神志而必须回避的清单最顶端。

lines.en: And if there’s a face or a smell or a voice that takes me back to any degree, even if it’s the slightest, I will cut them out without question and return to how I’ve always been.
lines.zh: 而如果有某张脸、某种气味、某个声音，在某种程度上把我带回去——哪怕只有一丝一毫——我都会毫不犹豫地把它们剔除，然后回到我一贯的样子。

lines.en: Safe. Content. And trapped somewhere no one can hurt me unless they force their way in.
lines.zh: 安全。满足。困在一个除非有人硬闯进来、否则谁也伤不到我的地方。

lines.en: scene kandasjog1
It was similar for the Kanda sisters — two girls who, while not having endured recent stressful situations {i}together,{/i} did ultimately wind up in the same place through similar circumstances.
lines.zh: 神田姐妹的情况也差不多——两个女孩虽然没有{i}一起{/i}熬过近期的高压处境，最终却因相似的境遇走到了同一个地方。

lines.en: Each one trusted someone they shouldn’t have. And each one found themselves repeatedly dry heaving in the middle of the night when unwanted dreams wearing masks of memories crept in.
lines.zh: 她们各自都信任了不该信任的人。她们各自都发现自己会在半夜反复干呕，当那些戴着记忆面具的不速之梦悄悄爬进来的时候。

lines.en: {size=-2}So while the scents and sounds in question would contend with the words that dotted the sky like clouds just moments ago, showing us that you don’t need to {i}be{/i} together to {i}be{/i} together, there was still something about the face.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}所以，尽管那些气味与声音会和刚刚像云朵一样点缀天空的言语相抗衡，向我们展示“不一定要在一起才能在一起”，但那张脸仍然有某种东西。{/size}

lines.en: The one that looked down on them — with a mask you can’t hang on your wall. The kind that changes based on who is looking at it and when. There was something about {i}that.{/i}
lines.zh: 那张俯视着她们的脸——戴着一张你没法挂在墙上的面具。那种会随着谁在看、什么时候看而变化的面具。{i}那张脸{/i}有某种东西。

lines.en: And maybe it was just because they’d fall asleep under the same sky, protected by the same walls that were now being shattered by my greatest fear.
lines.zh: 也许只是因为她们会睡在同一片天空下，受着同样的墙保护，而那些墙此刻正被我最大的恐惧砸碎。

lines.en: {size=-2}Maybe it was because of {i}that{/i} that they didn’t technically {i}need{/i} to endure something together but, instead, could just convince themselves they’re not alone beneath the watchful eyes of a spiteful god.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}也许正因为如此，她们其实并不真的需要一起熬过什么，而只需要说服自己：在一个怀有恶意的神明注视下，她们并不孤单。{/size}

lines.en: Unfortunately, however, it matters not what someone thinks so long as God is watching.
lines.zh: 然而不幸的是，只要神在看着，别人怎么想都不重要。

lines.en: And that, sooner rather than later, they’d be pulled from home like the doll house it is to become a late night snack for someone better.
lines.zh: 而她们迟早会像从那座玩具屋里被拽出来一样，离开家，成为某个更优秀之人的深夜点心。

lines.en: But even then, it’s better being ground into paste against the molars of a beast when someone else’s screams are present to distract you from your own.
lines.zh: 但即便如此，被野兽的臼齿碾成糊状时，若有别人的尖叫在场，好歹能让你从自己的尖叫里分神。

lines.en: Stay hydrated.
lines.zh: 记得补水。

lines.en: Stay sinless.
lines.zh: 保持无罪。

lines.en: : You’re staring at me a lot today and I don’t like it.
lines.zh: : 你今天老盯着我看，我不喜欢。

lines.en: : I’m just happy we started jogging together. I’d always wish you were here when I came alone.
lines.zh: : 我只是很高兴我们开始一起慢跑了。我一个人来的时候，总希望你在。

lines.en: : Why? All I do is slow you down.
lines.zh: : 为什么？我只会拖你后腿。

lines.en: : Because it’s not {i}about{/i} speed, Kirin! Jogging’s great for when it comes to refocusing your mind and getting your priorities in order.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}重点{/i}不是速度，Kirin！慢跑很适合用来重新集中注意力、把优先事项理顺。

lines.en: : And having you here makes me glad that you’re not just sitting on the couch eating sweets all morning.
lines.zh: : 而且你在这儿，我很高兴你不是整个早上都窝在沙发上吃甜食。

lines.en: scene kandasjog2
: Plus — I kind of just love you. And being with people you love is something that makes {i}everyone{/i} happy.
lines.zh: : 而且——我大概就是爱你。和自己爱的人在一起，是能让{i}人{/i}幸福的事。

lines.en: : Gross. You could have just said having a second set of eyes here helps protect you from voyeurs or something.
lines.zh: : 恶心。你干脆说多一双眼睛在这儿能保护你不受偷窥狂骚扰之类的不就好了。

lines.en: : Which, come to think of it, I’m getting bad vibes from that dude in the trench coat over there and suggest that we change our route.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，那边那个穿风衣的家伙给我的感觉很不好，我建议我们换条路线。

lines.en: : Oh, that’s just Akechi-san. He always comes here to Facetime with his daughter in the morning. I’ve had to give him directions a few times in the past. I think he might have dementia or something.
lines.zh: : 哦，那是 Akechi 先生。他每天早上都来这儿跟女儿 Facetime。我以前给他指过几次路。我觉得他可能有老年痴呆什么的。

lines.en: : He looks like he’s filming us.
lines.zh: : 他看起来像在拍我们。

lines.en: : Are you sure? He’s probably just showing the park to his daughter.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？他大概只是在给女儿看这个公园。

lines.en: : Sure. Or maybe his daughter is just an excuse he uses to come here and get new footage for his Karin Kanda spank bank every morning.
lines.zh: : 当然。或者也许“女儿”只是他每天来这儿、为他的 Karin Kanda 自慰素材库拍新片子的借口。

lines.en: scene kandasjog3
: Kirin, ew! He’s like eighty years old! You’re supposed to respect your elders!
lines.zh: : Kirin，恶心！他都八十岁了！你应该尊重长辈！

lines.en: : Yeah, but since when does that include letting them jerk off to secret videos they take of me from a bench in the park?
lines.zh: : 是啊，可从什么时候起，尊重长辈还包括放任他们对着从公园长椅上偷拍我的视频打飞机？

lines.en: : Akechi-san’s not like that. You just think he is because you have a dirty mind and he happens to be wearing a trench coat.
lines.zh: : Akechi 先生不是那种人。你只是因为你脑子脏，而他恰好穿了件风衣，才觉得他是。

lines.en: scene kandasjog4
: Then why is his hand down his pants right now?
lines.zh: : 那他的手现在为什么在裤子里？

lines.en: : Probably because he-
lines.zh: : 大概是因为他——

lines.en: scene kandasjog5
: Oh no.
lines.zh: : 哦不。

lines.en: : You really need to stop giving creepy people the benefit of the doubt, sis. It’s this point in life that normal people start outgrowing their purity and replacing it with common sense.
lines.zh: : 你真的别再给变态的人预设善意了，姐。正常人在这个年纪早就褪掉那份纯真，换上常识了。

lines.en: : I’m starting to think all those times he dropped things while I was passing him weren’t accidental either...
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得，以前我路过他身边时他掉东西，也不是不小心了……

lines.en: : Yeah. Maybe you just shouldn’t come here anymore.
lines.zh: : 是啊。也许你以后不该再来这儿了。

lines.en: scene kandasjog6
: Wanna take a break? Somewhere...on the opposite side of the park?
lines.zh: : 想休息一下吗？去……公园另一头？

lines.en: : Can I go snatch that old guy’s phone really quick and toss it into the fountain?
lines.zh: : 我能去把那老头的手机抢过来扔进喷泉里吗？

lines.en: : Only if you’re sure you can make it look like an accident.
lines.zh: : 只要你确定能让它看起来像场意外。

lines.en: scene kandasjog7
: Challenge accepted.
lines.zh: : 接受挑战。

lines.en: scene kandasjog8
: So yeah, I think it’s safe to say he won’t be coming here anymore. Both literally and...I guess {i}also{/i} literally but in a grosser way.
lines.zh: : 那么，我想可以肯定地说，他以后不会再来了。字面意义上的，而且……大概{i}也{/i}是字面意义上的，只不过是更恶心那种。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Kirin. If I’d known there were perverts here, I obviously would have suggested going somewhere else to jog.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Kirin。如果我知道这儿有变态，我显然会建议换个地方慢跑。

lines.en: scene kandasjog9
: There are perverts everywhere, sis. You could be sitting next to one right now and you wouldn’t even know it.
lines.zh: : 姐，变态到处都有。也许你现在旁边就坐着一个，而你根本不会知道。

lines.en: : Except I {i}do{/i} know it because you have gotten increasingly worse at concealing it these last few years.
lines.zh: : 可我{i}知道{/i}啊，因为你这几年来掩饰得越来越差了。

lines.en: : At least I’m not out in public letting senior citizens masturbate to me. For all {i}I{/i} know, you were doing that on purpose and I just ruined all the fun.
lines.zh: : 至少{i}我{/i}不会在公共场合让老年人对着我自慰。说不定你其实是故意的，而我刚好毁了你的乐趣。

lines.en: : Kirin, we do this to {i}refocus{/i} our minds, remember? You’re doing essentially the complete opposite of that right now.
lines.zh: : Kirin，我们慢跑是为了{i}重新集中{/i}注意力，记得吗？你现在做的跟那个完全相反。

lines.en: scene kandasjog10
: {i}You{/i} do this to refocus your mind. I’ve been doing it so we can spend more time together. And also keep myself in shape, I guess.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}是为了重新集中注意力。我一直是为了能跟你多待一会儿。还有，大概也是为了保持身材。

lines.en: : You...sorry, what? Could you repeat that?
lines.zh: : 你……抱歉，什么？你能再说一遍吗？

lines.en: : No. It was embarrassing enough the first time.
lines.zh: : 不要。说第一遍已经够丢人了。

lines.en: scene kandasjog11
: This is the happiest day of my life. Even if I just found out someone was taking candid photos of me.
lines.zh: : 这是我这辈子最开心的一天。哪怕我刚发现有人在偷拍我。

lines.en: : Don’t think {i}too{/i} much about it or it might interfere with all of that “refocusing” you’re trying to do.
lines.zh: : 别想{i}太{/i}多，不然会影响你正在做的那个“重新集中注意力”。

lines.en: scene kandasjog12
: I will do literally anything to preserve this moment in time. Just say it and it shall be done.
lines.zh: : 只要能把这一刻永远保存下来，我什么都愿意做。你说吧，我照办。

lines.en: : Don’t make it weird, please.
lines.zh: : 请别把它变得奇怪。

lines.en: : That is literally the one thing I can {i}not{/i} do. I am sorry.
lines.zh: : 这恰恰是我唯一做{i}不{/i}到的事。抱歉。

lines.en: : Wonderful. I should have just kept my mouth shut.
lines.zh: : 太好了。我当初就该闭嘴。

lines.en: scene kandasjog13
: Where did that even come from? Is everything okay? Do you {i}need{/i} something? How can I help?
lines.zh: : 这到底是从哪儿冒出来的？一切都好吗？你{i}需要{/i}什么吗？我能帮上什么忙？

lines.en: : Just doing some reflecting lately. Trying to be less...terrible and all that. And I know I’ve been sort of...unfairly taking some of my frustrations out on you for a long time.
lines.zh: : 只是最近在反省。想变得不那么……糟糕什么的。而且我知道，我好像一直……把自己的挫败感不公平地发泄在你身上很久了。

lines.en: : Kirin, I’m scared. Are you dying?
lines.zh: : Kirin，我害怕。你快死了吗？

lines.en: scene kandasjog14
: I’m not dying! I just...don’t have time for superficial hatred anymore! And you’re the only person who’s ever on my side 100%% of the time, so...this is like an investment!
lines.zh: : 我没有要死！我只是……没时间再去做那种肤浅的憎恨了！而你是唯一一个 100%% 站在我这边的人，所以……这算是投资！

lines.en: : An investment?
lines.zh: : 投资？

lines.en: : Yeah! I stop being mean to you and you...make me feel good about myself or something! That’s how sibling relationships are supposed to work, right?!
lines.zh: : 对！我不再对你刻薄，然后你……让我对自己感觉好一点什么的！姐妹关系本来就该是这样运作的，对吧？！

lines.en: scene kandasjog15
: Heh...yeah. That’s one way for it to work...
lines.zh: : 呵……是啊。这也算一种运作方式……

lines.en: : I’m sorry for...being such a bitch all the time, Karin.
lines.zh: : 我为……一直这么 bitch 道歉，Karin。

lines.en: : And I guess I’ll just...pre-apologize now in the event that it happens again in the future. Which it probably will since changing is way harder than I thought it would be.
lines.zh: : 而且我想我现在就……提前道个歉，以防以后再犯。而我大概还会再犯，因为改变比我以为的难多了。

lines.en: : Why do you want to change at all, Kirin? Like...did something inspire this or what?
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么想改变呢，Kirin？比如……是有什么事触动了你，还是怎样？

lines.en: scene kandasjog16
: Hah...
: You can take your time if you need to. We don’t even need to do it today. I just want to be sure you’re okay and-
lines.zh: : 需要的话你可以慢慢来。我们今天甚至不必聊这个。我只是想确认你没事，然后——

lines.en: : I’m...{i}fine.{/i} It’s just, like...
lines.zh: : 我……{i}没事{/i}。只是，那个……

lines.en: scene kandasjog17
: You know how when we were on the soccer team together and I couldn’t ever keep up with anybody, I always got upset about it and, like...stormed off or whatever?
lines.zh: : 你还记得我们以前一起在足球队的时候吗，我永远跟不上任何人，我总是为此生气，然后……气冲冲地走掉什么的？

lines.en: : It feels like my whole life has been just...{i}that.{/i} Watching everyone else pull ahead and lashing out because of jealousy or sadness.
lines.zh: : 感觉我整个人生就是……{i}那样{/i}。看着别人一个个超过去，然后因为嫉妒或难过而发作。

lines.en: : I’m just tired of it. I want something of my {i}own{/i} now. And I keep telling myself it’s {i}okay{/i} if someone is better than me at it, but...I can’t bring myself to actually {i}believe{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 我只是累了。我现在想要属于{i}自己{/i}的东西。我一直告诉自己，就算有人在这方面比我强也{i}没关系{/i}，可……我没办法真的{i}相信{/i}。

lines.en: : So maybe I just need more positivity around me or...something. I don’t know. Noriko helps, but Noriko isn’t you.
lines.zh: : 所以也许我只是需要身边多点正面的东西，或者……什么的。我不知道。Noriko 能帮我，但 Noriko 不是你。

lines.en: : I guess none of it really matters, though. Even talking about it like {i}this{/i} feels childish and I should probably just shut up if I want to seem serious about anything.
lines.zh: : 不过我想这些大概都不重要。连{i}这样{/i}讲出来都显得幼稚，如果我想让任何事显得认真，我应该闭嘴才对。

lines.en: : You’re wrong.
lines.zh: : 你错了。

lines.en: scene kandasjog18
: It’s not childish at all, Kirin. And anything you need, if it’s within my power to help you, I will.
lines.zh: : 这一点也不幼稚，Kirin。而你需要什么，只要在我能力范围内，我都会帮你。

lines.en: : So if there’s ever anything in life you choose to not feel bad about, please just make it this. Chasing after happiness shouldn’t ever come with negatives like that.
lines.zh: : 所以如果这一生有什么事你可以选择不为之感到内疚，那请就是这件事。追求幸福从来不该附带那样的负面代价。

lines.en: : Yeah...I know. And that’s sort of exactly what I thought you’d say, so thank you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我知道。而且这差不多就是我料到你会说的话，所以谢谢你。

lines.en: : But you know...you can count on {i}me{/i} too, Karin.
lines.zh: : 不过你知道吗……你也可以依靠{i}我{/i}，Karin。

lines.en: : I know. And I do.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我也确实依靠你。

lines.en: scene kandasjog19
: {i}Do you,{/i} though? Because you always say that but, when push comes to shove, you’d rather face your problems alone than drag me into them.
lines.zh: : 你{i}真的{/i}吗？因为你嘴上总那么说，可真到了紧要关头，你宁愿独自面对问题，也不愿把我拖进来。

lines.en: : Well, I...uhh...there are just...certain problems you {i}shouldn’t{/i} be dragged into. And my priority as an older sister is keeping {i}you{/i} happy, so-
lines.zh: : 嗯，我……呃……只是有些……问题你{i}不该{/i}被卷进来。而我作为姐姐的首要任务是让{i}你{/i}开心，所以——

lines.en: : Your priority should be yourself. It’s not fair if you’re the only one sacrificing herself for her sibling. I want to do that too. You just won’t {i}let{/i} me.
lines.zh: : 你的首要任务应该是你自己。如果只有你一个人为兄弟姐妹牺牲，那不公平。我也想那么做。只是你{i}不肯{/i}给我机会。

lines.en: : If it’s a trust thing, I get it. Like, {i}I{/i} wouldn’t trust me either. But-
lines.zh: : 如果是不信任的问题，{i}我{/i}理解。比如，换成我，我也不会信任自己。但是——

lines.en: : It’s not like that...
lines.zh: : 不是那么回事……

lines.en: scene kandasjog20
: I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : You know how I am. How I’m...not really {i}good{/i} when it comes to adult stuff. Like, even today — I didn’t get what was going on with Akechi-san until you blatantly pointed it out to me.
lines.zh: : 你知道我是什么样的人。我在……成人那套事情上真的{i}不太行{/i}。比如，就连今天——直到你直白地指出来，我才明白 Akechi 先生是怎么回事。

lines.en: : So I just...have a hard time dealing with certain things {i}in general.{/i} And some of those things only get harder when you’re brought into the picture, so...
lines.zh: : 所以我就是……{i}总体上很{/i}难应付某些事。而其中有些事一旦把你牵扯进来只会更难，所以……

lines.en: : It’s not about not trusting you at all. It’s more just...needing to figure out what to do.
lines.zh: : 这完全不是不信任你。更像是……需要想清楚该怎么做。

lines.en: scene kandasjog21
: I guess we’ve both got some work to do then. So here’s hoping jogging can somehow fix all of our issues.
lines.zh: : 那看来我们俩都有功课要做。那么，就指望慢跑能莫名其妙地把我们所有问题都治好吧。

lines.en: : It won’t fix all of them, but it could help fix some. And we can help each other with the rest of them.
lines.zh: : 它治不好全部，但也许能治好一部分。剩下的我们可以互相帮忙。

lines.en: : Deal. Can we focus on fixing my stomach first, though? I skipped breakfast this morning since I didn’t want to eat before running and I am now paying the price for that.
lines.zh: : 成交。不过能不能先治治我的胃？我今天早上没吃早饭，因为不想跑前吃东西，现在正在为此付出代价。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I’m hungry too.
lines.zh: : 好啊。我也饿了。

lines.en: scene kandasjog22
: Koi Cafe isn’t far. We can-
lines.zh: : Koi Cafe 不远。我们可以——

lines.en: scene kandasjog23
: No. Absolutely not. Literally anywhere else is fine.
lines.zh: : 不。绝对不行。其他任何地方都行。

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...
: Did...did something happen...there?
lines.zh: : 是不是……在那儿发生过什么……？

lines.en: scene kandasjog24
: Well, uhh...not technically {i}there{/i} but just...
lines.zh: : 嗯，呃……严格说不是在{i}那儿{/i}，只是……

lines.en: : T...Take all that stuff you said about not knowing how to deal with certain things a minute ago and just copy-paste it here. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 把……把你一分钟前说的那些不知道怎么应付某些事的话复制粘贴到这里。谢谢。

lines.en: : So...it didn’t happen {i}there,{/i} but it’s obviously connected...
lines.zh: : 所以……不是在{i}那儿{/i}发生的，但显然跟那儿有关……

lines.en: : Did...something happen with...Rin or Molly, maybe? You didn’t come home for a few days after your Christmalloween party, so if there was something that happened there-
lines.zh: : 是不是……Rin 或者 Molly 出了什么事？你 Christmalloween 派对之后有几天没回家，所以如果那时候发生了什么——

lines.en: : Just drop it, okay? You already know who I like and I don’t have any intention of doing {i}anything{/i} romantic with anyone else. Full stop.
lines.zh: : 别问了，好吗？你喜欢谁你已经知道了，我也不打算跟其他人搞{i}什么{/i}浪漫。到此为止。

lines.en: : Okay. But A — I didn’t mention romance. And B — I feel like, as your older sister, I should probably also use this moment to tell you that you shouldn’t be doing anything romantic with an adult either.
lines.zh: : 好。不过第一——我没提浪漫。第二——我觉得，作为你姐姐，我大概也该借这个机会告诉你，你也不该跟一个成年人搞浪漫。

lines.en: scene kandasjog25
: Y...You liked him too until some stuff happened that you refused to ever tell me about! So don’t act like I’m the one doing something wrong just because {i}you’re{/i} not into him anymore!
lines.zh: : 你……你以前也喜欢他，直到发生了一些你死也不肯告诉我的事！所以别装得好像因为{i}你{/i}现在不喜欢他了，就是我在做错事！

lines.en: : I’m older than you, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 我比你大，Kirin。

lines.en: : By a {i}year!{/i} So what?!
lines.zh: : 大{i}一岁{/i}！那又怎样？！

lines.en: scene kandasjog26
: A year and a half. But even if it was a {i}day{/i} and a half, it wouldn’t change anything.
lines.zh: : 一岁半。不过就算只大{i}一天{/i}半，也不会改变任何事。

lines.en: : What matters is that I learned firsthand just how blind I was being and that, looking back on it now, what I was feeling wasn’t {i}romantic{/i} at all. It was immature...hormonal...confusion.
lines.zh: : 重要的是我亲身体验到自己当初有多盲目，而现在回头看，我当时的感觉根本不是{i}爱情{/i}。那是幼稚……荷尔蒙……混乱。

lines.en: : And if I knew what Sensei was really like from the beginning, I never would have felt that way at all.
lines.zh: : 如果我一开始就知道老师真正的样子，我根本不会有那种感觉。

lines.en: : You {i}still{/i} feel it, you fucking liar. You’re just pretending not to because things got too real when you went out to karaoke one night and convinced yourself he actually {i}wanted{/i} to hurt you.
lines.zh: : 你现在{i}还{/i}有那种感觉，你这个该死的骗子。你只是装作没有，因为有一晚你们去唱卡拉 OK，事情变得太真实，你就说服自己相信他是真的{i}想{/i}伤害你。

lines.en: scene kandasjog27
: Wha...how...why do you...
lines.zh: : 什……怎么……你为什么……

lines.en: : Because you’re not the only one who was there, Karin! And, spoiler alert, Sensei has a mouth too!
lines.zh: : 因为当时在那儿的不止你一个人，Karin！而且，剧透一下，老师也长着嘴！

lines.en: : So don’t give me shit about not telling you stuff when you did the same with me!
lines.zh: : 所以别因为我也没告诉你一些事就冲我发火！

lines.en: scene kandasjog28
: He...{i}told{/i} you about that?
lines.zh: : 他……跟你{i}说了{/i}那件事？

lines.en: : Not willingly. I had to fucking drag it out of him because he felt so bad about the whole ordeal that he filed it into his overflowing cabinet of {i}other{/i} horrible repressed memories!
lines.zh: : 不是自愿的。我他妈的是硬从他嘴里撬出来的，因为他对整件事内疚得要死，把它归档进了那个塞满了{i}其他{/i}可怕压抑记忆的柜子里！

lines.en: : But he still {i}told{/i} you. The words came out of his mouth.
lines.zh: : 可他还是{i}告诉{/i}你了。那些话是从他嘴里说出来的。

lines.en: : No, I just put fucking two and two together because I’m not an innocent little girl anymore, Karin!
lines.zh: : 不，我只是他妈的把两件事拼到了一起，因为我不再是那个天真的小女孩了，Karin！

lines.en: : I have common fucking sense! And when two people I love get into some shit together, I want to find out what it is!
lines.zh: : 我有他妈的常识！而当我爱的两个人一起惹上什么事，我想搞清楚那是什么！

lines.en: scene kandasjog29

: And {i}yes!{/i} I {i}did{/i} just say “love!” Because no matter how many times I tell myself it isn’t true or that I don’t deserve to feel this way, {i}I love him!{/i} I love him, Karin! Love, love, love, love, love!
lines.zh: : 而且{i}对{/i}！我刚刚{i}就是{/i}说了“爱”！因为不管我告诉自己多少次这不是真的、我不配这么感觉，{i}我爱他{/i}！我爱他，Karin！爱、爱、爱、爱、爱！

lines.en: : You don’t, Kirin...It’s {i}not{/i} love. It only feels like it is because he’s the only person you’ve ever felt that way {i}about.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你不爱，Kirin……那{i}不是{/i}爱。你之所以觉得是，只因为他是你唯一一个有过这种感觉的人。

lines.en: : So {i}what?!{/i} If anything, I think that’s proof that it {i}is{/i} love!
lines.zh: : 那又{i}怎样{/i}？！要说的话，我倒觉得这恰恰证明那{i}就是{/i}爱！

lines.en: : {size=-4}Who gives a shit if I change my mind years down the line when all I want right {i}now{/i} is to marry him and start a family and fucking...teach our daughters how to play soccer and go to Tokyo Disneyland and a million {i}other{/i} things I never even {i}dreamed{/i} of wanting before I met him!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-4}谁在乎多年以后我会不会改主意，反正我现在想要的，就是嫁给他、组建家庭，还有他妈的……教我们的女儿踢足球、去东京迪士尼，以及一百万件在遇见他之前我连做梦都没想过的事！{/size}

lines.en: : You’re gonna look at me and tell me that isn’t love?! What do you know?! You could be a {i}hundred{/i} years older than me and still be wrong about this! I. LOVE. SENSEI. The end!
lines.zh: : 你看着我，然后告诉我那不是爱？！你懂什么？！你就算比我大{i}一百{/i}年，在这件事上也照样是错的！我。爱。老师。完毕！

lines.en: : He’s {i}twice{/i} your age, Kirin! Just...please {i}think{/i} about what you’re saying.
lines.zh: : 他年纪是你{i}两倍{/i}，Kirin！拜托……{i}想想{/i}你在说什么。

lines.en: : You think I {i}haven’t?!{/i} That’s why I went after him in the first place!
lines.zh: : 你以为我{i}没想过{/i}？！这正是我当初追他的原因！

lines.en: : I just wanted {i}someone{/i} to distract me from how fucking sad and unwanted I’ve always felt and I figured he’d be an easy target! I didn’t expect {i}this{/i} to happen! But it did, and now I’m happy!
lines.zh: : 我只是想要{i}有人{/i}能让我分神，不去想我一直以来有多他妈的难过、多不被需要，而我觉得他是个容易得手的目标！我没料到会变成{i}这样{/i}！可它就是发生了，而我现在很幸福！

lines.en: : {size=-4}So you can either be happy {i}for{/i} me or you can run off to Mom and Dad and burn down the {i}first{/i} good thing I’ve ever had in my life because you think you know what’s better for me than I do! What’s it gonna be, Karin?!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-4}所以你要么为我高兴，要么就跑去爸妈那儿告状，把我这辈子唯一一件好事烧个精光，因为你觉得你比我更清楚什么对我好！你选吧，Karin？！{/size}

lines.en: : There are so many good things, Kirin...{i}so many.{/i} All around you...You really think {i}he{/i} is the first?
lines.zh: : 有太多好事了，Kirin……{i}太多{/i}了。就在你身边……你真觉得{i}他{/i}是第一个？

lines.en: scene kandasjog30
: If you want to get technical about it, fine. {i}You{/i} were the first. And I said I love you too, didn’t I? But that just makes it even more important to me that you understand this, Karin.
lines.zh: : 如果你想抠字眼，行。{i}你{/i}是第一个。我也说过我爱你，不是吗？可那只会让我更希望你能理解这件事，Karin。

lines.en: : I know it’s morally {i}fucked.{/i} And I know what happened with you guys. And yes, that makes me {i}very{/i} mad. But it doesn’t change how I feel. It doesn’t change what I dream of.
lines.zh: : 我知道这在道德上很{i}操蛋{/i}。我也知道你们之间发生了什么。没错，那让我{i}很{/i}生气。可它改变不了我的感觉。改变不了我的梦想。

lines.en: : And it {i}really{/i} doesn’t change how it feels when he says that he loves {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而它{i}真的{/i}改变不了他说爱{i}我{/i}的时候的那种感觉。

lines.en: : Did he...really tell you that?...
lines.zh: : 他……真的跟你说了那句话吗？……

lines.en: : Or when he kisses me...
lines.zh: : 或者他吻我的时候……

lines.en: : Kirin-
lines.zh: : Kirin——

lines.en: : I love him so much...
lines.zh: : 我好爱他……

lines.en: : So why...
lines.zh: : 那么为什么……

lines.en: scene sky
: Why did I do that?...
lines.zh: : 我为什么要做那种事？……

lines.en: The sky looks down on both sisters, now causing a scene in a local park, and it chuckles to itself — tossing javelins of light down at them and piercing their hearts as the spectacle unfolds.
lines.zh: 天空俯视着此刻正在公园里闹成一片的两姐妹，暗自轻笑——把一道道光的标枪掷向她们，在这出戏上演时刺穿她们的心。

lines.en: Neither girl really understands, but they can feel the burn as it pierces through them.
lines.zh: 两个女孩都不太明白，却能感到它刺穿自己时的灼痛。

lines.en: Just one hates it.
lines.zh: 只是其中一个痛恨那种感觉。

lines.en: And the other wants more.
lines.zh: 而另一个想要更多。

lines.zh: {i}Kirin 的好感度提升到了 [kirin_love]!{/i}
